Average years of schooling, males vs. females
2023
Average number of years adults over 25 years participated in formal education.
Data source: UNDP, Human Development Report (2025)
Note: Formal education is primary/ISCED 1 or higher. This does not include years spent repeating grades. Where a country or region lacks data
for the year shown, the closest available value within 10 years is shown instead.
